subject: Hosted API pricing — volume confirmation & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@scaleapps.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing — volume confirmation & next steps

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to hear more about Scale Apps' roadmap and the bursty campaigns you mentioned. Quick recap + a couple of asks so we can get you a concise hosted-API pricing estimate: 

Recap from our call:
- Use case: conversational customer support + short-form generation for marketing flows.
- Traffic shape: steady baseline with several hourly/daily bursts tied to campaigns.
- Model profile: 1-2B parameter generation models for replies; some embeddings for search/rerank.
- Security: SOC2 required; standard hosted API with encrypted logs is acceptable for pilot.

Info we need to finalize pricing (can reply inline):
1) Expected monthly token volume (pilot month and 6-12mo steady state).
2) Expected peak tokens-per-second (peak TPS) during campaigns / bursts.
3) Rough split generation vs embeddings (%).
4) Budget target or target $/1M tokens (if you have one) and any PO/finance constraints.

If easier, you can reply with a short table. Based on what you shared, we can produce:
- A hosted API price plan with volume tiers and burst pricing for short-term peaks, and
- A quick cost comparison showing what Dedicated would look like if you expect sustained >= 2-3k TPS.

Next steps: I’ll attach a preliminary pricing estimate once I have the numbers above. We can also schedule a 30-min pricing review with Rishi (engineering) and Ben (sales ops) to walk through unit economics and tradeoffs.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

--
Redwood Inference | High-performance LLM inference (hosted, dedicated, private)

From: Samir Shah <samir@scaleapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Bennett <kyleb@scaleapps.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — volume confirmation & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap. Below are the numbers that should let you put together a realistic estimate. I added Kyle (platform) for any infra questions.

Pilot (first 30 days):
- Expected monthly tokens: ~120,000,000 tokens (conservative).
- Peak TPS (burst): ~800 tokens/sec (typically short bursts, ~1-5 minutes).

Steady-state (3-6 months):
- Expected monthly tokens: ~650,000,000 tokens (we expect increased adoption after initial launch).
- Peak TPS (campaigns): planning for up to ~3,000 tokens/sec during marketing pushes (these are short-lived but frequent).

Token mix: ~85% generation (chat/completions), ~15% embeddings.

Budget / unit economics:
- Target $/1M tokens: $5-7 (we’re trying to hit ~$6/1M tokens in steady state).
- Monthly budget range (pilot -> steady): $700-4,000 (pilot) and $3,000-40,000 (steady, depending on adoption).

SLOs/requirements:
- 95th pct latency target: <= 600ms for single-shot generation requests.
- SOC2 is necessary; will ask security team for questionnaire soon.

Let me know if you need further breakdowns (tokens per request, avg prompt + completion lengths) — we can pull usage histograms from our test harness.

Thanks,
Samir Shah
Head of Product, Scale Apps Inc
samir@scaleapps.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@scaleapps.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — volume confirmation & next steps

Appreciate the detail, Samir — this is perfect.

What I’ll do next: 
1) Put together a concise hosted-API pricing estimate with 3 volume tiers (pilot, mid, steady) that maps to your target ~$6/1M tokens and shows blended monthly cost given your generation/embeddings split.
2) Add an appendix with burst handling guidance (how we manage short peaks, autoscaling/burst credits, and when Dedicated becomes cost-effective). Given the ~3k TPS peak you called out, we’ll surface a Dedicated cost example for sustained bursts.
3) Attach the draft pricing PDF (RDW_pricing_estimate_ScaleApps_v1.pdf) and link the HubSpot deal (RDW-4821).

Proposed 30-min follow-up: Thu Jul 22, 11:00am PT to review the estimate and unit economics. Can you + Kyle and Rishi confirm availability? If not, propose two alternate times and I’ll lock it.

I’ve uploaded the draft estimate to the Drive and linked it in the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4821.

If everything looks good we can also kick off a short SOC2 evidence exchange (I’ll send the security questionnaire separately).

Thanks again — attaching the PDF now.

Best,
